ocr.notes: First paragraph's list of celebrities is badly garbled; the rest is mostly right

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reprinted the New York World's account of a sparring reception for Tom Allen at Central Hall in the Bowery, where Allen sparred Dwyer of Brooklyn and promised to do his duty against McCoole.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, October 1, 1869

facts.fact: Allen visited New York City, where friends gave him a sparring reception at Central Hall, Hotel du Nord, in the Bowery
places: Central Hall, Hotel du Nord, Bowery, New York

facts.fact: Allen sparred three rounds with Dwyer of Brooklyn at the reception
places: Central Hall, Hotel du Nord, Bowery, New York

facts.fact: Allen made a speech of thanks and assured the crowd he would do his duty in his coming fight with McCoole

notes: The World of the 28th ult. says the event was 'last evening', so about September 27, 1869. Dwyer's first name is not given; Johnny Dwyer is likely (see 370)
